recommended_action: Design a real-CDN decompression-normalization experiment using Cloudflare Workers or Fastly Compute@Edge as a CDN proxy in front of the localhost mock server. The CDN proxy should: (1) apply real brotli/gzip compression with Accept-Encoding negotiation; (2) use auth-aware cache configuration (Cache-Control: private / Vary: Authorization with Authorization in cache key) as positive control, plus default (URL, Accept-Encoding) cache key as negative control; (3) apply chunked transfer-encoding. Test all 4 auth states x JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB with iterative decompression max_depth=5. Include a non-chunked passthrough control to isolate chunked TE effect. Resolve the frozen spec decision rule contradiction (c1 vs c4) before designing: condition (1) should apply only to auth-aware cells, not naive cells. If iterative decompression survives real CDN with auth-aware cache configuration, C-MEAS-VALID decompression-normalization reaches the threshold for VALIDATED status.
